title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: St Augustine Amphitheatre, St Augustine | 2022
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the St Augustine Amphitheatre in St Augustine, Florida, USA, on 15 September 2022.

It was the 17th show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s 2022 tour of North America, which lasted for 30 dates between May and October 2022.

Starr had previously performed at the St Augustine Amphitheatre on 17 July 2010 and 29 June 2012. He returned there on 22 June 2025.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
